concepts.gloss_en: The tzaddik is the foundation of the world (Proverbs 10:25)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences carry the identical vocalized fixed phrase צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם, a direct quotation of Proverbs 10:25, and all are used in the same sense (the tzaddik as cosmic foundation, e.g. equated with Yesod d'Atzilut in lm1:34). The two surface variants differ only by quotation marks, not by word or meaning. Single concept.
